text.zh: Atlas 圆轨道教学模型设计

note.en: DESIGN: synthetic circular orbits; fixed Earth axis; active rotations; finite Sun sphere/disc tangents; no atmospheric lunar brightness, ephemeris or dates. D=24 acos(−tan latitude tan declination)/π; k=(1+cos phase)/2. Nominal radii and periods are sourced in S8–S10. See docs/44 §4 for the full equations.
note.zh: 设计：合成圆轨道、固定地轴、主动旋转、有限太阳球体/视盘切线；无月食大气亮度、星历或日期。日长=24 acos(−tan纬度 tan赤纬)/π；亮部=(1+cos相角)/2。名义半径和周期取自S8至S10。完整公式见docs/44第4节。
